sources.title: BrightRate-LM/README.md at main · shreshthsaini/BrightRate-LM
sources.snippet: BrightRate-LM BrightRate-LM assesses the perceptual quality of user-generated HDR video from a multi-exposure frame stack. It returns a 0 to 100 score, a short description of visible defects, and reasoning for the score. This work extends BrightRate (WACV 2026) with a multimodal language model and a controlled study of HDR input representations.
